source: PDF native image for layout; registered Yale native source for stroke measurements
purpose: Mark writing regions without naming, matching, or interpreting signs. Region review is acquisition annotation, not training of unit families.
rules: Mark rectangles enclosing visually evident straight writing blocks, preserving source image coordinates.
Split writing blocks on opposite sides of an illustration into separate regions where paths do not clearly continue through it.
Record drawings crossing a writing block as contamination; a region rectangle does not prove all enclosed ink is writing.
Mark circular, radial, rotated, sparse-label and ambiguous writing separately; do not flatten them into horizontal rows.
Provide an uncertainty margin and preserve omissions. Low-resolution layout previews cannot establish unit boundaries.
Candidate paths, component memberships, and segmentation cuts remain unaccepted until a source crop audit.
No EVA, RF, v101, language, hand, or positional-assay output may be consulted to choose region or unit boundaries.
independence: Region annotation may be performed on held-out images after this rule freeze. Unit family learning and parameter choice use train views only; final unit evaluation uses held-out views without refit.
coverage_required: Every folio-captioned view must receive a coverage record, including explicit abstentions.
pixel_measurement_rule: Native Yale pixel position and ordinal group rank are separate quantities. Reduced contact sheets are for layout review only.
rejected_methods: whole-row classifier with midpoint negative labels
whole-row classifier with inadequate negative-view diversity
local-window classifier with poor cross-view recall
pen_lift_rule: Unresolved by default; a raster disconnect does not establish a pen lift.
